title: DB-232: the zoning-lot warning from the city's recorded-document index (ACRIS): where a recorded zoning lot description names the lot with another lot on the same block, every lot-area figure carries a zoning-lot condition; flag only, the zoning lot is never concluded
objective: Read the ACRIS index (Legals, Master; metadata only) through a new fail-closed connector, classify the lot's recorded zoning-lot documents into five states, and carry a property-specific zoning-lot condition on every lot-area figure and building alternative when a zoning lot description names another lot on the same block or the index cannot be read; add the scope row and the first open item; update NB-01 (revision 3) and the review register in the same change.
business_reason: The owner's reviewer found the benchmark's 20,150 sq ft shown without its property-specific zoning-lot concern (lots 1 and 70; D-094 R029); the generic sentence is not enough once the city's index names both lots (record NB-01; backlog DB-232).

acceptance_scenarios.given: the recorded benchmark replay: a ZONE (zoning lot description) indexed against lot 70 and lot 1 on block 7334, with a DECL and a CERT on the same lots
acceptance_scenarios.then: state OTHER_LOTS_NAMED naming 4073340001; the four floor-area values, the standard unit limit, coverage and rear yard where shown, and building B carry one zoning-lot condition naming lot 1 and City Register file 2022000059134; numbers unchanged; DECL and CERT listed as reminders; scope row zoning_lot 'Not confirmed'; the report's first open item is 'Zoning lot'

acceptance_scenarios.given: a ZONE indexed against the subject lot alone (synthetic, labelled)
acceptance_scenarios.then: SINGLE_LOT_ONLY: no new condition; the scope sentence says it lists a description filed on this lot alone, not read

acceptance_scenarios.given: no documents, or deeds and mortgages only
acceptance_scenarios.then: NONE_FOUND: no new condition; the scope sentence names the as-of date and says this is not a title search; never worded as 'no zoning-lot issue'

acceptance_scenarios.given: the index cannot be read (timeout; 503 after retries; HTTP 400 no-such-column; page budget reached; a subject document with no Master row)
acceptance_scenarios.then: NOT_READ: the zoning-lot condition is added ('could not be read'); the route still answers 200; never 'none found'

acceptance_scenarios.given: a ZONE indexed against the subject and a lot on another block (synthetic)
acceptance_scenarios.then: no same-block warning; the other-block lot is listed for checking only; a mixed document triggers only on same-block lots

acceptance_scenarios.given: a DECL or CERT on several lots with no ZONE; or a ZONE whose subject row is partial_lot P
acceptance_scenarios.then: DECL/CERT alone: reminder only, no condition; partial_lot P on a ZONE: the figures carry the condition

acceptance_scenarios.given: no provider bound (the new flag off, the production default)
acceptance_scenarios.then: NOT_CHECKED: the results document is byte-identical to the output before this task

acceptance_scenarios.when: any value citing 4073340070:lot_area or any building alternative is shown
acceptance_scenarios.then: it carries the zoning-lot condition; no combined lot area and no remainder computed from the 39,934 sq ft DOB field appear anywhere (guard test)

acceptance_scenarios.when: it builds requests and parses replies
acceptance_scenarios.then: the BBL is normalized before any request; no request asks for document_amt or the Parties dataset; ZONE/DECL/CERT descriptions are pinned and checked against the recorded 7isb-wh4c copy; tests run offline by exact-URL replay

risks: An index entry is not the instrument; nothing here establishes the zoning lot (NB-01 stays access_blocked).

Plan P-2 decided 'a reminder only; no records check' and the plan lists ACRIS as 'flag only, per P-2': this task reads index metadata to make the reminder property-specific and never concludes the zoning lot or computes transfers (reading recorded for the directive check).
Zoning lots declared only by a DECL, cross-block developments and condominium/air-rights lots are not caught; NONE_FOUND is not a title search.
Shares result-way files, the journey fixture, snapshots and web tests with M5-T157: part B starts only after M5-T157's commits are on the branch; fixtures regenerated once after both.
